name: GFCI Relay Control
author: jrobpuck
description: Arms/disarms an external GFCI relay board around FPP scheduled shows, monitors for GFCI trips, and sends SMS/push notifications.
_comment_manual_install: This plugin is installed manually via install.sh, not through FPP's Plugin Manager, so the versions[]/branch/sha fields below are informational only and are never read by a git-clone install flow. Fill in homeURL/srcURL/bugURL once this repo has a real remote.
